title: Give ChatGPT a simple story idea and have it generate a professional storyboard…
content:
Give ChatGPT a simple story idea and have it generate a professional storyboard with cinematic continuity.  
Upload the storyboard back to ChatGPT and have it convert every frame into a director-level Seedance 2.0 video prompt.  
Upload the storyboard plus the generated video prompts to Seedance 2.0 to produce the final animated film sequence.
